batting.name: BB McCullum
batting.dismissal: c TL Suman b RJ Harris

batting.name: SC Ganguly
batting.dismissal: c RJ Harris b RG Sharma

batting.name: BJ Hodge
batting.dismissal: c Harmeet Singh b RJ Harris

batting.name: WP Saha
batting.dismissal: c RP Singh b A Symonds

batting.name: AC Gilchrist
batting.dismissal: c LR Shukla b BJ Hodge

batting.name: HH Gibbs
batting.dismissal: c DJ Hussey b M Kartik

balls.text: fails to make contact, bowled on a good length on middle, looks to heave it away, misses
mistimes a slog wide of long-on, gets a couple for his efforts

run out, tries to whip it fine, gets hit on the waist and it drops on the pitch, rushes off for a single but Gilchrist is onto it quickly, flicking it onto the stumps at the non-striker's end to find Hussey well short
feeding them with length balls here, full and wide, makes room and carts it over deep cover for the biggest of his four sixes
holes out in the deep, full and wide, makes room and slices it in front of deep cover, RP is late to get onto it but covers good ground to dive forward and pluck a sharp catch
Saha gets into the act now, bowled on a length on the off, gets forward and slogs it over deep square leg to get the score past 150, well done

28 off the over, the most expensive of the IPL, got under it nicely, length ball on middle, smacked it over long-on this time for an even bigger six, will this make the difference in the outcome of this game?
the best over of the innings, poor ball, short outside off, makes room and swats it over the bowler's head, over the long-off boundary for a big six, what a nice little cameo from Hussey here
two more, low full toss on leg stump, clipped wide of deep midwicket, massive slip-up from Deccan this over
lofted it wide of long-on and deep midwicket, bowled on a length, just chips it and gets a couple
Harmeet's no better, hands him a gift, short and wide, Hussey makes room and swats it into the bug gap between long-off and deep cover, four more

poor ball, another waist-high no ball, costly stuff, moves across and whips it away wide of short fine for a boundary, RP can't bowl anymore, his second no-ball for height and the rule stipulates that the bowler is out of the attack if he does that
short of a length outside off, guided to short third for a single
full toss on leg stump, mistimes a pull to deep square leg, just over the waist so given a no-ball
yorker on middle, just manages to get his bat down, digs it out into the off side for a single
caught at short fine, short on middle, makes way to pull it over midwicket, mistimes it, gets the top-edge straight to Harmeet Singh, Hodge goes after a fine knock
makes room and the bowler chases him, hurs it on a length outside leg, driven down crisply to long-off
misses out this time, bowled short outside off, tries to pull it away, doesn't connect
shot, low full toss on middle, frees his arms and swings it away wide of a diving Venugopal Rao at deep midwicket for a boundary
in the slot on middle and leg, struck straight to Harris who fumbles, Hussey had backed up too far and the bowler had a chance to run him out, but didn't hold on
slower one bowled on a good length on the off, pushed down to long-on, keeps the strike, decent over
banged in short on leg stump, pulled away to deep square leg
fullish outside off, evades the non-striker this time, drilled past him to long-off
slower one on the off, comes down the track and drives it cleanly but straight into his partner at the non-striker's end
banged it short outside off, went for the pull but failed to make contact
well run, came back in just a touch, driven just wide of long-off, Hodge rushes back for the second
strays down the leg side, given a wide, gifts a run
back of a length outside off, cut away wide of deep point for a couple, Hodge continues his good form
they're picking up pace now, bowled full on middle, swept away firmly between deep square leg and deep midwicket for four more
beaten this time, good length on the off and spun away to beat the prod, Gilchrist fumbles to concede a bye
excellent shot, gave it some air, charged down the track, got to the pitch and struck it cleanly inside out over the deep-cover boundary for a flat six
good length on the off, dropped short of cover for a single
turned away, produced the edge as he tried to work that away, spun away at the last moment, gets a single to point
spoils the over, bowled short on middle, a long hop, dealt with appropriately by Hodge who swivels and pulls it away behind square leg
the end of a struggle, slightly short on the off, made room and tried to clear long-off, no timing on that one, landed safe in the hands of Harris
fullish outside off, bunts it down to deep cover for a single
yorker length on leg stump, gets a thick inside edge to short fine for a single
shortish on the off, slaps it over the bowler's head, doesn't time it well, still gets two in front of the two fielders in the deep

fullish on middle and leg, pushed away wide of midwicket for a single. Atrocious fielding, Rohit fails to collect an underam throw and allows them to come back for two more, diverting the ball towards long-off
drags it towards deep midwicket for a single
squeezes a four, finally, drilled through the off side wide of extra cover, Gibbs ran well to his left, dived to pull it back in but instead, palmed it onto the ropes
doesn't play that shot too often, tried to scoop it but didn't time it well, got the top edge that just cleared Ojha at short fine
was in the slot, but missed out, full and wide, took his left leg out to clear the leg-side, missed
slower one bowled short outside off, slapped down to long-off
forced through the leg side towards deep midwicket for a single
in the blockhole but digs it out in the gap, in the vacant midwicket region and gets a couple
quicker one bowled flat outside off, attempts to swat it through the in-field, mistimes it again
quicker one bowled flat on middle and off, tries to smash it down the ground but mistimes it back to the bowler
flighted on middle, worked away towards midwicket at the circle, enough time for them to make the single
quickish on the off, pushed back to the bowler
shortish on the off, cut away to deep cover off the back foot
tossed up on the leg stump, driven down to long-on for a single
saw him come down and bowled it full, Ganguly almost yorked himself there, digging it out into the leg side
short of a length outside off, bunts it down to deep cover
turned away into the leg side wide of midwicket for a single
dabbed back to the bowler from the crease
Ojha hurls it flat, Ganguly reaches forward, is not quite to the pitch but still manages to make sound contact, slog-sweeping it between deep midwicket and deep square leg for a boundary
fullish outside off, pushed through to deep cover for a single to keep the strike
good length outside off, mistimes a drive wide of extra cover for a quick single
on middle and off, pushed through gently towards long-on, the fielder isn't onto it quickly and they scamper a couple
shortish outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single
excellent shot, just a fraction wide, stays his ground and slashes it hard wide of a diving point for a pressure-relieving boundary
short of a length outside off, pulled away to deep midwicket

appeal for run out, gets out in some peculiar ways sometime, dropped into the off side by Hodge, sets off for a single, Ganguly rams his bat into the ground and it slips out of his hands just as the the fielder scores a direct hit at his end, replays show he had just made it in
spun away sharply, beaten, got on the back foot to defend but was done in by the spin
shrugged off the pain there, how do i know?? He charged down the track to that one, was a full toss, swung it towards deep midwicket

struck right in the zone, came down the track to swing it away over midwicket, it spun in and bang!! He's in a bit of pain there, who wouldn't? Didn't look pleasant on the replay. Moral victory for Ojha there
delicately done, but just for a single, spun back in from outside off, tried to late-cut it, they take a single but the umpire sends them back, didn't think Ganguly was attempting a shot there
spun away from the off, pushed wide of midwicket for a single
fullish on the off, driven towards long-off for a single
swung back in, fullish on the off, pushed to mid-off
back of a length outside off, chops it down wide of point where the fielder dives full length to his right to save a couple of runs
bunts it to long-on for a single, this partnership worth 18 now
stump-to-stump this time, lands on a good length on middle, defended back to the bowler
good relief, short on the off, a long hop, rocks back and pulls it away through square leg, powerfully struck
good length on the off, gets forward and taps it watchfully towards cover
slower one on middle and off, moves across and paddles it over short fine for a couple
on middle and leg, pushed away into the vacant midwicket region, Symonds runs and cuts it off, keeps them down to just a single
good length on the off, taps it short of mid-off and cover for a quick single
fullish on middle and leg, tickled behind square for a single
dropped into the leg side for a single
dropped in the direction of square leg, think of a run but ultimately decide against it

appeal for obstructing the field, tucked away to short fine, Ganguly was racing towards the non-striker's end and came in way of the throw, replays indicate he made an attempt to stop the ball, hanging out his left hand, controversial
short of a length outside off, mistimes a slap, heads straight onto the stumps at the non-striker's end, they get a run off the ricochet
back of a length on the off, jabs it down to deep midwicket
lands on a good length on the off, comes down and swats it straight to mid-on, didn't time it too well
back of a length on the the off, punched to point
gets on the front foot and punches it in front of cover
on middle and leg, clipped away behind square wide of fine leg for a couple, made possible mainly due to a ill-timed slide as the fielder palms the ball away to concede the extra run
moving in, short of a good length on the off, punched back to the bowler
good length on the off, pushed to cover
some swing into the batsman, worked away to square leg
a dead ball, no shot offered as it clips the pads on the way to the fine-leg boundary, Harmeet Singh pulls it back
back of a length on middle, pushed wide of midwicket for a quick single
fullish on middle, driven back to the bowler, done so crisply but unable to beat the gap
slightly short on the off, rocks back and squeezes it between the widish slip and gully for a single to third man

gives it away this time, survived a couple of scares but fails to take advantage, short on the off, usually plays the pull well but not quite so this time, got the top edge and Suman at square leg ran back a few steps to pouch a well-judged catch
just manages to clear mid-off, waked across to work it wide of midwicket but rhe away-movement induced a leading edge, gets a couple
shortish on the off, pushed to cover off the back foot
dropped, Gibbs was stationed perfectly at a shortish point for that shot, slashed away really hard but he failed to hold on, reacted a little late perhaps but you would expect him to snap those
length ball outside off, came back in just a touch, pushed off the front foot firmly to mid-off
came back in after landing on a good length outside off, opens the face to drop it towards point
that's dismissed, banged in short outside off, perfect length for McCullum, gets forward hint and smashes it over deep midwicket, all power there, a crowd killer
straying on the pads, clipped wide of a squarish fine leg for a couple, a valiant diving save prevents a couple of runs
down the leg side, there have been too many of these at the wrong times in this tournament
fullish on the off, pushed back to the bowler
slightly short on the off, pushed to cover, stands tall and dabs it
decent pace, bowled at 136.4 kmph, pushed to point off the back foot
a touch fortunate there, was almost bowled through the gate but for the inside edge as he tried to swat that down the ground, came back in after pitching outside off
straightish on leg stump, fails to work it away and gets hit on the pads instead
short on middle, whips it away, one bounce to RP Singh at fine leg who fumbles but recovers well
gets a thick inside edge between square leg and midwicket as he tries to force that through the off side, a hint of inswing for Harris
back of a length outside off, gets back and dabs it to point
banged in short, a bouncer on middle, Ganguly ducks under it well
good length on the off, pushes at it, gets a thick outside edge to third man for a single
back of a length on the off, gets back and punches it to cover
much better, pitched it fuller on the off, gets across and pushes it to mid-on
gets the treatment, a real loosener, short and wide, latches onto it, dispatching it between cover and cover point for a boundary
short of a length outside off, moves away and Ganguly lets it go
slightly short on the off, leaps up and drops it dead on the pitch
back of a length outside off, left alone to the keeper
whips it off his pads, slightly short on leg stump, turns it away really fine to beat fine leg, who's a little too square
straying in line slightly, tries to clip it fine, gets hit on the thighs and squeezes a leg bye
beaten, good bounce, landed on a good length outside off, shot up and swung away to beat his prod
it's all over, short on middle, pulls it away well over the fine-leg boundary to seal a thrilling victory, can Kolkata ever win?
four, four, four, Mashrafe has spoilt it for Kolkata, full and wide, makes room and carts it wide of a diving cover to beat long-off to the boundary
full and wide, swatted down to long-on, scampers back for the second, Rao runs well to finish the run
wide, Mashrafe, what the hell are you doing? Hurls it well wide of the offstump, Rohit lets it go wisely and the umpire frees his arms

meaty, juicy full toss on middle, the worst ball you can bowl under the circumstances, heaved away over midwicket for a massive six, what a timely blow, 8 off 3 now, 115 metres that, one of the biggest of the tournament
a scare there, full and wide, made room to cream that through the covers, got a thick outside edge that landed on the bounce to third man, just a single
misses out, full just a fraction outside off, moves across to paddle it fine, is it on the pads, just a run

Rohit's taken four of those, full toss on middle, pulled away to the deep square-leg boundary, called a no-ball by the leg umpire as there are only three fielders in the ring, what a slip up, drama right at the death. McCullum isn't happy, but if there were just three inside the circle, the call is a right one. The Kolkata captain is disputing the decision, and continues arguing with the umpire, but the decision's been made. It's a no-ball, that's final. An extra ball conceded. How costly will it prove?
superb over under the circumstances, yorker on middle, makes room and all he can do is dab it to short third, has Agarkar sealed it for Kolkata here?
full toss on the off, bumps it down towards Agarkar who palms it off into the off side to concede a single
low full toss outside off, bends low to drag that over midwicket, gets an inside edge onto his pads and only salvages a single, what an over, he's redeemed himself here, thus far at least
good length on the off, makes room and drags it past the bowler towards long-on for a couple
crucial dot ball, in the slot on the leg stump, tries to swing it away over midwicket, gets an inside edge to the keeper o the bounce, well bowled, targeting leg stump and almost got it through
well bowled, yorker on middle, bang on target, dug out into the leg side for a single
low full toss again, steered towards deep point, excellent over from Mashrafe, had a poor outing before this but struck good at the right time
in the blockhole again, converts it into a low full toss and drives that wide of long-off for a quick couple, 28 needed off 13, stiff ask
full and wide, hung his bat out, would have been a wide if he hadn't, got a thick outside edge on the bounce to the keeper
full toss outside off, punched down to deep cover, Kolkata won't mind this at all
low full toss on leg stump, flicked away towards deep square leg for a single
fullish on middle and leg, doesn't prove costly, drives it straight to long-on for a single

run out, he's bowled a superb yorker, dug out into the off side and rushes off, Mashrafe runs forward, collects and throws down the stumps at the non-striker's end despite Symonds blocking his view to find him well short, big wicket, a potentially decisive one, he's overstepped through, concedes a freehit, but what a big scalp
beautifully timed, straying on the pads, a gift ball really, clips it away stylishly to pierce the gap between deep square leg and fine leg, crucial four, Agarkar's leaked 13
fullish outside off, moves across and flicks it towards Ishant at deep square leg for a single
that's clobbered, in the slot on middle, faltering the same way as he did against Bangalore, planted his foot forward and smashed it over long-on for a big six
length ball outside off, smashed but straight to cover, dot ball

run out, good one, yorker length on the off, thumped down towards long-off, accurate throw from Hodge at the non-striker's end, Suman is struggling to reach, Agarkar collects well, clips off the bails to find Suman just short
hurls it full and wide, Symonds makes room and slices it over point wide of third man for a couple
in the blockhole, Symonds makes room and digs it out towards deep cover, Ishant is done, bowled a decent spell
short on middle, whipped away to fine leg for a single
adding insult to injury, makes him pay for the lapse, similar delivery, full and wide, made room and drove it powerfully between cover and mid-off
dropped by Kartik at mid-off, length ball, crashed straight to him off the front foot, was in the perfect position, but failed to pouch it
struck powerfully but straight to deep cover, full and wide, made room, went at it hard but failed to find the gap
short of a good length on the off, chopped down to third man for a single
fetches it from outside off to push it wide of long-on for a single
back of a length outside off, punched down to deep cover off the back foot
slower through the air, dabs at it after charging forward, gets a inside edge through the keeper's legs for a single

bowled quick and flat outside off, came down the track to smash that over mid-off, got a thick edge towards short third as it turned away, a shy at the non-striker's end but Kartik failed to collect it, lucky escape for he would have been gone had that hit
tossed up on middle, pushes it wide of long-on, placed it well for a couple
good length on the off, flicked away wide of midwicket for a couple more, 12 off the over, good one for Deccan
edged and four, pushed through the line, was bowled fullish on the off, plays inside the line, gets a thick edge to beat the diving keeper
short of a good length outside off, makes room to cart that over cover, makes no contact
poor ball, bowled short on middle and leg, swivels and pulls it really fine, beating fine leg to the boundary
back of a length on the off, played it really late, opening the face to guide it to third man
shortish on middle and leg, pushed away wide of midwicket for a single
flat and full on middle and leg, comes down the track and drives it to long-on to keep the strike
beaten there, slightly short outside off, tries to slash it hard, makes no contact
short of a length on leg stump and spinning towards off, dropped short of midwicket for a quick single
Kartik strikes! Bowled it short on middle, a long hop that should have been dismissed but Gibbs didn't get the elevation, rocked back and pulled it straight to Hussey at deep midwicket
spun away as he made room to cut, missed, looks for a wide to be signaled by the umpire, but gets nothing
short of a good length outside off, turned away sharply, pushed to cover
tossed up on middle, got under it, stayed his ground and smashed it over deep midwicket for a massive six, that'll ease the pressure
came round the wicket to the right hander, spun back in, reached for it, got the inside edge onto the keeper's boots, signaled as a bye but there was clear contact with the bat
floating into the leg stump, turned away towards deep square leg
short and wide, rocks back and bunts it to deep cover
steps out and carts it over extra cover, wide of deep cover for a couple, he is stepping up now
angling it into middle, comes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler, excellent over from Ishant, just the one run
banged in short on middle, worked short of deep square leg for a single
playing away from his body, swings away to beat the outside edge as he drives at it, the pressure builds
short and wide, reaches to slash it towards third man, makes no contact
back of a length on the off, bowled at 137.2 kmph, dabbed to point
fullish on middle and leg, clipped off his pads towards fine leg
gets across and works it away to deep square leg for a single
flighted on the off, driven down the ground to long-on
quickish outside off, defended short of cover
tossed up outside off, gets across and tickles it behind square for a single

a timely wicket for Kolkata, tossed up outside off, a little slower through the air, reached for it and tried to sweep it square, it turned, went off the top edge and sailed towards Laxmi Shukla at deep square leg who judged it well diving to his right, though it did seem for a second it would pop out, but he clasped it well in the end
bowled flat on the off stump, pushed back to the bowler
spun back in to strike him high on the pads as he tried to drop it on the off side
tossed up on the off, drills it down to long-off for a single
short of a good length outside off, rocks back and slaps it wide of Ishant at long-off who fumbles and allows them to come back for the second
tossed up on middle, lands full, swipes it wide of deep midwicket for a single
coming round the wicket, bowled flat on middle, dropped into the leg side and sets off
fullish on middle and leg, tickled to short fine for a quick single
back of a length outside off, punched firmly off the back foot to deep cover there, bowled to his field this time, he had cover in the deep
five in a row now, short on leg stump, fails to get it away, pulls it on the bounce to fine leg, will be disappointed he didn't find the gap
is not spared the fourth time, poor length, short and wide, cuts it away hard behind point to beat a diving third man to the boundary, raced away
short on the off, three in a row, slaps it over the bowler's head, wide of long-on for a couple
short and wide, Gilchrist misses out, slashed hard but made no contact, two short ones from Agarkar straightaway
Gibbs gives him the charge immediately, bowls it short on middle, pulled away to deep square leg
spun back in from the off, dabbed it delicately to short third, end of another tidy over from Karthik
sliding it on the pads, flicked away behind square for a single
quicker one on middle and off, defended onto the pitch
quicker one bowled flat on the off, spun away, withdrew his bat
full toss and gets a couple, working it away between long-on and deep midwicket
beats Gibbs again, fishes for it outside off, but is almost done in by the spin as it zips away
tossed up outside off, makes room and slices it down to point
slightly short outside off, chops it down to short third

finds the gap, came round the wicket, dropped it short outside off, Gilchrist rocked back, waited for it to spin away and bunted it through the gap between cover and cover point, a great attempt by McCullum to hurls himself to drag it back but isn't successful
full toss outside off, comes down the track and swats it down to long-on
excellent placement, gave him the charge, bowls it full outside off, takes it on the half-volley and drives it cleanly between cover and mid-off
goes for the sweep immediately, plays it to short fine, bowled flat outside off
low full toss on middle, pushed to midwicket, end of an excellent over, the change has brought about a sudden change in tempo, lets see how long it lasts
quicker one bowled flat on the off stump, driven down to long-off for a single
four dot balls, tries to sweep it down fine, is hit on the pads, rolls down to short fine
plays it watchfully again, pushing it back to the bowler
flat and full on middle, defended towards mid-on off the front foot
beaten right away, spun away from the off stump as he tried to open the face
and spoils it further with another gift, full toss outside off, eased through the gap between mid-off and cover for four more
coming round the wicket, gets it into the blockhole on leg stump, dug out to midwicket, well bowled this time
punished, he's looked ordinary in his first outing, low full toss on middle, drives it firmly back past the bowler, all along the ground for a boundary
yorker length, probably his best ball so far, dug out towards point
a fraction short outside off, safes hot as he swats it over McCullum at mid-off, clears him comfortably though it wasn't well timed, gets a couple
short and wide again, not great pace either, bowled at 122.2 kmph, chopped down to point, will feel he missed out there
he's had a bad start, hurls it too wide of the offstump, Gilchrist fails to reach it but is given a run
slow, short and wide, 113kmh, Gibbs reaches across and slaps it towards point
a touch slower from Ishant, length ball just outside off, Gibbs shows us his forward defence
and another, this was a short ball, Gibbs was again charging down the track, flat bats it over the bowler's head for another four

Gibbs joins the fun, he sashayed down the track to get to the pitch of the ball and carves it past cover, a diving fielder gets a hand in the circle but there's enough power in that shot to take it for four
back of a length, on the pads, Gilchrist tried to clip it to leg off the backfoot, inside edge onto pad takes the ball towards short third man
Gilchrist living dangerously here, wide and outside off, Gilchrist to cut, gets a bottom-edge that just bounces short of the keeper

direct hit and it would have been curtains for Gilchrist, Gibbs played that with soft hands towards point, batsmen went for a quick single, Gilchrist was struggling to make his ground, the throw misses and there's an overthrow as well
a high full toss just outside off from Mortaza, Gilchrist swats it towards midwicket for a single
and another, this was not as big as the previous one, only went a couple of rows back over midwicket, Gilchrist doesn't care
bang! no edge on that one, a shortish ball and on legstump, Gilchirst swung it high over deep midwicket for a massive six, way into the crowd
ooh, an inside edge saved Gilchrist there, fullish on middle and off, Gilchrist wanted to whip it to square leg, inside edge onto pads
Mortaza starts off with a nice, full delivery, on middle and leg pushed towards mid-on by Gilchrist
swung back in, lands on a length on the off, swatted down to mid-on
angling it in to Gibbs, tries to push it into the leg side, got his front foot across and was rapped on the pads but that was sliding down
opens the face to guide it wide of Hodge a point for a single, valiant attempt by the fielder there, but fumbles to concede a single

is lucky, just a wild swing, wasn't even there to the pitch, slightly fuller on the off stump, looked to clear midwicket, it moved away to take the outside edge, flew past third man for a one bounce four
getting some nice movement away from the left hander, tried to drop it into the off side, missed it again
beats Gilchrist straight away, got it to shape away from the left hander, landed on a good length on the off and swung away
